basis: Human agreement after concrete daily/product and historical group examples and Lead recommendation

daily.user_domain: all distinct Users in entire frozen observation capture
daily.scope: inclusive requested natural dates and explicit products affect observations only
daily.transitions: all adjacent natural-day pairs within request, including unchanged; one day has zero pairs

history.same_target_overlap: distinct source IDs retained; complete relationship links set-deduplicated

scope: Business policy accepted; not implementation or acceptance evidence
